INSTALL A CODE MOD

For BONELAB on Windows PC.

  1. Install MelonLoader and BoneLib if you do not already have them.
  2. Close BONELAB and download the mod’s .dll file. If you choose the ZIP, extract it first.
  3. Put the DLL in the game’s Mods folder. Replace the previous copy of that same mod.
  4. Start BONELAB. For God Man, open BoneMenu → God Man → Immortal. For Level Selector, open the game’s Levels menu.
DEFAULT STEAM FOLDERC:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\BONELAB\Mods

Code mod DLLs go in the game’s folder. Your downloaded maps and avatars use a separate folder.
